page.notes: The black-letter German subtitle "Von Erben einsetzen" is set in Fraktur; it is rendered here in roman because the transcription tooling does not carry black letter, and the spelling "einsetzen" is uncertain (the scan reads "einsetzen"). Some words are doubtful: "Quin am", "exhaeredare", "instituii" and "posthumi" in the second paragraph and the line "Cogis" (catchword) are read from a slightly blurred scan. The italic "De haeredibus instituendis" heading is set in roman capitals with spacing, and the "Quomodo", "Suntne" and "Quid dicis" heads are italic lines, all treated as level 2. No marginal notes. The "Quis est decimus quartus titulus?" line is set in italic with spaced capitals and treated as a level 1 heading.
